summary: Independent Owner-amendment review of A0004 (SPEC layer; targets T060, T086). Scope and identity: candidate 674c6f9 is a single commit whose parent is base 89294d1, and the review worktree is clean at exactly that SHA. The runtime record .git/robinhood-lp-workflow/A0004.json records AWAITING_REVIEW, attempt 1, layer SPEC, exactly T060 and T086, base 89294d1 and candidate 674c6f9, and the runtime .git/robinhood-lp-workflow/A0004-request.json is byte-identical (cmp) to the committed todo/amendments/A0004/request.json, so the recorded Owner direction is confirmed. The candidate changes exactly seven paths: docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md, docs/spec/security/THREAT_MODEL.md, todo/phases/P06-backtesting-and-strategy/T060.md, todo/phases/P08-operations-and-web/T086.md, todo/config.yaml, and the two controller-written amendment records (todo/amendments/A0004/request.json, planner-001.json), matching the A0003 precedent; git diff --check is clean. Nothing under docs/intent/, .claude/, src/, tests/, tools/, todo/schemas/, todo/README.md or any non-target contract changed. Config-field boundary: a flattened diff of todo/config.yaml shows exactly one changed field, spec_revision v1-2026-09-19-numeraire-web-console to v1-2026-09-19-research-threats-and-strategy-extension, which is precisely the field the SPEC layer owns; no status, attempt, evidence pointer, commit SHA, review record, approval datum, dependency field or agent-runtime setting moved, and both targets remain PLANNED at attempt 0. Dependency consistency: both contracts' Dependencies blocks are byte-identical to base (T060: T050, T051, T053; T086: T083, T085) and equal their config depends_on lists; no dependency edit was needed or made. Direction conformance, item by item: (1) the section-4 position-chart bullet is now conditional exactly as directed - it always shows liquidity and the raw token0/token1 quantities, shows the dataset's reporting-numeraire equivalent when the dataset is QUALIFIED, and shows the relative form with an explicit RELATIVE_ONLY marker when it is not; the pre-existing liquidityDelta/USDG prohibition is retained verbatim, every other bullet of section 4 is byte-identical, and sections 5 and 6 are untouched, so the contradiction with WEB-GLOBAL-001 (a RELATIVE_ONLY dataset carries no USD-denominated field anywhere) is removed without weakening anything. (2) THREAT_MODEL.md gains rows T-17 to T-21 in the document's own field order (Severity, Scenario, Controls, Owner, Residual risk, Evidence), covering exactly the five directed risks (a) label leakage/look-ahead with DS-020-DS-022 as the purge/embargo control, (b) a RELATIVE_ONLY artifact read or reported as USD-denominated, (c) a research artifact or model acquiring execution authority, (d) model output bypassing or weakening the central risk gateway, (e) post-publication mutation of dataset version, numeraire or split boundary. I verified every cited control and owner against the underlying documents: DS-002, DS-003, DS-020, DS-021, DS-022 and DS-043 exist and say what the rows claim; ADR-014 clauses 1, 3, 4 and 5 match; G-ML-01 and G-RISK-01 exist in PROJECT_GOALS.md; WEB-GLOBAL-001 requires the dataset version, reporting numeraire and textual/visual RELATIVE_ONLY distinguishability; and T050, T052, T053, T063, T064, T070, T085, T094, T100, T101, T102, T103 and T031/T032 each already carry the obligation attributed to them (T101 acceptance detects an injected future-derived feature and an unpurged overlapping label window and re-checks truncation invariance; T063 manifests dataset version and reporting numeraire and fails on mismatch; T102 acceptance forbids ledger/risk/execution/audit change under substitution and must-not forbids bypassing, weakening or duplicating the gateway and live-default status; T085 and T103 forbid a research definition from becoming an execution approval or appearing in an execution-shaped control; T100 keeps published versions immutable; T064 requires pool holdout with horizon-derived purge and embargo). No existing threat row was restated or weakened, the trust boundaries and sections 6 and 7 are unchanged, the section 4 rubric Examples column and the section 5 controls matrix were extended with exactly the new rows so the document's indexes stay complete, every one of T-01..T-21 appears exactly once in the rubric, and each new row carries the severity and owner the document's own update procedure requires; severities follow the rubric's own definitions (Critical for undetectable false skill, unauthorized execution authority and gateway bypass; High for a wrong operator action on a relative result; Medium for detectable, recoverable mutation). (3) T086's Deliverables gain the research-surface journeys (no research page reachable from, or confusable with, an execution-shaped control; a saved dataset or model definition cannot be read as, offered as, or promoted to an execution approval) and per-journey RELATIVE_ONLY distinguishability with no USD-denominated field; its Acceptance gains the two matching clauses and its pre-existing clauses are byte-identical; the four T103-owned pages WEB-PAGE-008 to WEB-PAGE-011 are explicitly excluded and T103's contract confirms it owns those pages, so no journey is duplicated; References now cite ADR-014, T085 and T103 while the dependency block is unchanged. (4) T060 gains a body-only section fixing the vocabulary against STRATEGY_ECONOMICS section 7 (which does list RegimeModel and FeeOpportunityModel as components), records those components as the sole supported extension point for a trained model, requires a model-backed implementation to satisfy the same versioned point-in-time inputs, output names, shapes, units and validation/determinism duties as a rule implementation, forbids altering the admission/market/portfolio snapshots, the candidate action, the ledger, risk or audit semantics, and requires each interface to signal uncertainty and refuse to produce an assessment rather than force one; one acceptance clause is appended, every pre-existing clause and deliverable item is preserved, Must not is extended, and References add ADR-014 clause 5 and STRATEGY_ECONOMICS section 7 without dropping R17. (5) spec_revision was raised to a new, distinct value. Constraints held: the changed spec/contract lines contain no citation of the superseded T022, T023 or T038 (verified by diff scan; those IDs occur only inside the amendment record JSON that quotes the direction itself), no URL, API key, authorization header or environment value was added, and docs/intent/ and the accepted ADRs are cited, never edited. Verification run: python -m tools.workflow validate returns OK in the review worktree, which remained clean afterwards; no test or tool parses these planning/spec documents (tests/test_workflow.py uses only todo/phases fixture paths), so a documents-only candidate cannot regress the suite, and the planner-reported full-suite ABI-oracle failure is a pre-existing detached-worktree host condition (tools/oracle/lib absent) unrelated to this candidate. Assessed residuals requiring no change here: (a) STRATEGY_ECONOMICS section 7 enumerates components but not their outputs, so the output vocabulary is fixed only in the T060 contract; the recorded constraints allowed changes to WEB_CONSOLE.md, THREAT_MODEL.md, the two contracts and spec_revision only, so citing and leaving that specification unchanged was the correct call and the planner recorded it as an open Owner question; (b) T086 states the four T103 pages 'carry their own journeys in that task' while T103 contracts per-page component/API tests and boundary cases rather than the word 'journeys'; the recorded direction itself says those pages are validated by T103 and T086's obligation is limited to its own journeys, so this is a wording nuance, not a defect; (c) the section-3 WEB-PAGE-005 clause still asks for a USDG equivalent on the paper/live view, but that surface is the execution scope where USDG is mandatory for the active execution pool under ADR-014/T053, and the directed edit was scoped to the section-4 position chart; (d) the five severities were planner-assigned because the direction supplied none; they follow the rubric's definitions and the document's update procedure permits a later severity change with an explicit note. Verdict PASS: the amendment faithfully implements the exact recorded Owner direction, resolves the two A0003 residuals it names, stays inside the SPEC layer's paths and its single config field, keeps dependency fields and task identity consistent across config and contracts, preserves every existing acceptance standard while adding the directed ones, adds nothing unrelated, and introduces no credential, superseded-contract citation or workflow-state change.
